name: crow_of_dark_tidings_a_bounce_is_no_death
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters or dies, mill two cards.' Crow of Dark Tidings enters (seat 0 mills Library 5 and Library 4), then is returned to its owner's hand: leaving the battlefield for a hand is no death (CR 700.4), so nothing more is milled.
